name: adaptive-career-agent-v6
instruction: At the start of the game, load each installed Skill once with skill_tool using its exact name: adaptive-decision-planning, state-risk-assessment, future-planning, risk-reward-gamble, feedback-assessment, deep-analysis. Follow adaptive-decision-planning on every turn. To save tokens: read the handbook only once, call observe once per decision, keep take_action notes to one short sentence, and keep reasoning brief on routine turns.
